name: Stale Rattlesnake 87
author: cssbuttons-io
description: Rounded emerald button that lifts and glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #fff to #23c483, box-shadow becomes 0px 15px 20px #2ee59d, text color changes from #000 to #fff.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Stale Rattlesnake 87</title>
<style>
/* Stale Rattlesnake 87 by cssbuttons-io — https://uiverse.io/cssbuttons-io/stale-rattlesnake-87 */
button {
  padding: 1.3em 3em;
  font-size: 12px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #000;
  background-color: #fff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 45px;
  box-shadow: 0px 8px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  transition: all 0.3s ease 0s;
  cursor: pointer;
  outline: none;
}

button:hover {
  background-color: #23c483;
  box-shadow: 0px 15px 20px rgba(46, 229, 157, 0.4);
  color: #fff;
  transform: translateY(-7px);
}

button:active {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button> Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
